idea-plugin.name: Mermaid Companion
idea-plugin.description:
A live preview for Mermaid diagram files (.mmd, .mermaid): zoom and pan, click a shape to jump to its line, copy or export the diagram, and real syntax errors in the editor. Rendering uses a bundled copy of mermaid.js, with no network calls.

Free

  • Preview tab next to the editor: zoom with Ctrl+mouse wheel or pinch, pan by dragging, fit and 100% buttons.
  • Click a shape to jump to its line: flowchart nodes and subgraphs, classes, states, ER entities, requirements, mindmap nodes and sequence participants. Links inside a diagram never open, and the preview never loads another page.
  • Copy to the clipboard as a PNG (1x or 2x) or as a Markdown code block ready for a README, and PNG export at 1x or 2x.
  • Keyword colors for every diagram type, with their own page in the color scheme settings, and syntax validation for flowchart, sequence and class diagrams: unterminated strings, unmatched or mismatched node-shape brackets, and subgraph blocks without end. Non-ASCII identifiers and labels are handled like any other.
  • Works alongside the JetBrains Mermaid plugin: choose once which editor opens Mermaid files, and switch any time from the Tools menu.

Mermaid Companion Pro (paid, with a free trial)

  • SVG export and Copy SVG Markup.
  • 13 diagram themes, independent of the IDE theme: mermaid.js's ten (Default, Neutral, Forest, Dark, Neo, Redux and their variants) plus High Contrast, Blueprint and Monochrome, with text contrast of 10:1 or more. A theme set in the diagram itself always wins.
  • Diagram looks: Classic, Hand-Drawn and Neo. Hand-Drawn changes flowcharts, class, state and ER diagrams.
  • PNG at 3x and with a transparent background, for export, Export on Save and the clipboard.
  • Export on Save: every save re-renders the diagram and rewrites its SVG and/or PNG next to the file. A diagram that fails to render leaves the previous export untouched, and an unchanged diagram leaves the file, and your Git history, alone (for gitGraph, give each commit an id: mermaid.js names commits without one at random). Sync Now and the last sync time are in the preview toolbar.

Diagram themes were free before version 2026.2.0; any installation that ran 2026.2.0 or later before November 2, 2026 keeps them without a license. SVG export was free before version 2026.3.0; any installation that runs 2026.3.0 or later before November 9, 2026 keeps it without a license. Those installations get the new themes and the diagram looks too. PNG at 1x and 2x is free either way.
